prompt:
Image 1 is a frame from our film and is the authority for this building's design, proportions, colours and weathering: the two-storey green clapboard saloon on the right of Image 1. Recreate exactly that saloon: faded sage-green painted horizontal clapboard with worn grey-white trim, a flat parapet roofline, four upper-storey windows, a covered front porch along the full width with thin square wooden posts and a shallow plank roof, two ground-floor windows either side of a pair of louvred wooden batwing doors in the centre, a raised plank porch floor with wooden steps.
Framing: one single image (not a collage, not a reference sheet) of only this building, seen in a three-quarter front view from slightly above eye level, the whole building in frame from its foundation to its roofline with clear margin on every side. It fills most of the frame.
Setting: it stands alone on a plain, seamless light-grey studio backdrop with a matching grey floor. No street, no dirt road, no sky, no hills, no other buildings, no people, no animals, no vehicles, no props other than those named above.
Light: soft, even, neutral studio light from the front, no harsh shadows, no sunset glow, no warm cast, no light coming from inside windows. Glass reads as dark, slightly reflective panes.
Materials are physical and real: sun-bleached sage-green paint flaking off the clapboard at the edges, grey weathered timber showing through, nail streaks, dusty porch planks. Photographic realism, natural colour, full-bleed image filling the whole frame; no film border, no caption, no watermark, no text, no lettering, no logos; any sign board is blank wood. Not an illustration, not a painting, no HDR, no sharpening.
